exposure: amniotic fluid (AF) natriuretic peptide (NP) levels (ANP, BNP, NT-proBNP)
outcome: severity of heart failure (HF) in fetuses
cohort: The study included 95 singletons with congenital heart defects (CHD) or arrhythmia and 96 controls.
finding: Amniotic fluid N-terminal pro-B-type NP (AF NT-proBNP) concentrations increase in stepwise fashion with the severity of heart failure in fetuses with CHD or arrhythmia, making it an optimal NP for assessing fetal HF.
